Select exact IC50 activity rows for CHEMBL1865 (HDAC6). Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures (INNER JOIN) to enforce presence of canonical_smiles. Join compound_records and docs to require PubMed-indexed provenance (pubmed_id IS NOT NULL). Join activities and assays to filter by assay CHEMBL1865 and standard_type IC50. Join target_dictionary to retrieve target metadata. Return all requested columns without deduplication. Cast activity_comment to NULL if it contains non-integer strings like 'Not Active'. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
